_comment: Gundam Universal Century manual watch order, drafted 2026-09-12, movie-trilogy swap-in added 2026-09-15. Supersedes the SmartLists version (IMDb list ls560971030, 'Gundam: Continuity Order') for two reasons the external list can't express: (1) mid-sequence placements no provider list supports (same limitation as Trigun/Votoms/.hack/Steins;Gate, see README) -- 'Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island' (2022, theatrical remake of TV ep 15) and 'G-Saviour' (2000, live-action UC 0223 endpoint, appended after Victory Gundam); (2) deliberate choice (2026-09-15, community-supported per digitalcitizen.life/peepstune.com watch-order guides) to use the 1981-82 Mobile Suit Gundam movie trilogy (Radarr ids 113/115/123, all hasFile:true, titles verified exact-match against Jellyfin) INSTEAD OF grabbing the 43-episode 1979 TV series (Sonarr id 170, deliberately left unmonitored) -- the trilogy covers the same story in ~7h vs ~17h and is the commonly-recommended entry point. Trilogy-to-episode mapping (confirms Doan's Island's slot): Movie I = TV ep 1-13, [ep 14-15 gap -- Doan's Island covers ep 15], Movie II = ep 16-30, Movie III = ep 31-43. IGLOO trilogy internal order corrected from release order to in-story chronology per Gundam Wiki/community sourcing (2026-09-12 session): Hidden One Year War (early war) -> Gravity Front (Battle of Odessa, mid-war) -> Apocalypse 0079 (final month, Solomon/A Baoa Qu) -- NOT release order, which is Hidden One Year War / Apocalypse 0079 / Gravity Front. DO NOT RUN until all pending Jellyseerr requests from the 2026-09-12 session finish importing -- build_playlist.py errors out on any title not yet present in Jellyfin. Series/movie 'name' values below are placeholders using common English titles (except the trilogy + IGLOO entries, verified live against Radarr 2026-09-15); verify the rest against the exact Jellyfin library Name once imported (Sonarr/Radarr import naming can differ, e.g. punctuation or subtitle placement) before running -- exact-match lookup in build_playlist.py will fail silently loud (SystemExit) on any mismatch, which is the cue to fix the title string here, not to guess further.
